isotropic_floor.note: with all product energy channelled to ions the electrons are still heated by ion-electron exchange, so Te stays at 72 keV and bremsstrahlung balances that exchange: the photon share cannot fall below about 9.5 % in a thermal burn. Compton trapping in the dense pellet lowers it by at most 3.3x (REDUCED_MODEL, sign unresolved).
